Which is the best open weights Image to Video model without audio?[图标] MiniMax H3 currently leads among open weights Image to Video models without audio in the Artificial Analysis Image to Video Arena with an Elo score of 1345, followed by Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video-4Step (Elo 1261) and Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video (Elo 1242). How does Image to Video differ from Text to Video?[图标] Text to Video models generate videos from text descriptions alone, while Image to Video models take an existing image as input and animate or extend it into a video. This allows for more control over the visual content and style of the generated video. How are Image to Video models ranked?[图标] Models are ranked using an Elo rating system derived from user votes in blind comparisons. Users compare videos generated from the same input image and choose the result they prefer. Higher Elo scores indicate a model is preferred more often.
